name: Cancel order
description: Cancel an order that has not shipped, with explicit confirmation.

slots.name: order_id
slots.prompt: I can cancel that if it has not shipped. What is the order ID?
slots.retry_prompt: I need the order ID, for example ORD-1234.

nodes.prompt: This will cancel ${slots.order_id} and cannot be undone. Should I go ahead?
nodes.message: Okay, I will not cancel it.
You will not be charged for this order. Is there anything else I can help with?
Let me connect you with an order specialist who can help.
